AI.motivation: To understand how barriers to healthcare for international migrants shape patterns of multimorbidity and disease co-occurrence, beyond single-disease prevalence comparisons.
AI.method: Nationwide inpatient dataset (~13M admissions, ~4M individuals). Created 1:1 age-, sex-, and first-admission-time-matched cohorts of Austrian nationals vs non-Austrian migrants (272,779 each). Compared disease prevalences and constructed comorbidity networks (overall and sex-stratified) to identify differential disease-pair co-occurrences between groups.
AI.result: After matching, metabolic/cardiovascular diagnoses (e.g., T2D, MI) were more common in non-Austrians; depression was more common in Austrians. Of disease-pairs differing between groups, ~70% had stronger co-occurrence in Austrians, ~30% stronger in non-Austrians. Sex-specific patterns: Austrian males—stronger links between alcohol use disorder and mental health; non-Austrian males—more acute somatic conditions; non-Austrian females—cluster of recurrent depression, somatoform disorders, dorsalgia.
AI.conclusion: Fewer comorbidity links among migrants are interpreted as evidence of structural access and diagnostic barriers (language, cultural factors, crisis-oriented admissions), though healthy migrant effects may also contribute. Authors recommend culturally sensitive care and earlier identification of multimorbidity in migrants.

title: Biophysics of the Pyrenoid
summary:
Phase-separated liquid droplets organize molecules in cells, but the underlying physical principles differ from abiotic mixing and quantitative rules in living systems remain poorly understood. The pyrenoid -- a liquid-like organelle that enhances photosynthetic carbon fixation in algae and hornworts -- provides an unusually tractable model system. Here, we review recent advances in our understanding of pyrenoids from the perspective of biophysics. We highlight how reaction-diffusion models connect compartment architecture to catalytic performance, how soft matter theories link molecular interactions to condensate assembly, and how modern experimental methods enable these predictions to be tested quantitatively. Recent studies suggest that pyrenoid function may be described by a small number of effective
  transport and reaction processes, while condensate assembly can be understood through molecular design parameters and thermodynamic constraints. Together, these findings establish the pyrenoid as a powerful system for investigating catalytic compartmentalization, biomolecular self-organization and the emergence of effective physical descriptions in living systems.

AI.tldr: Pyrenoid을 모델로 한 연구는 반응-확산 모델과 연성물질 이론을 결합해 촉매적 구획화와 응집체 조립을 소수의 유효 전달·반응 과정과 분자 설계·열역학적 제약으로 설명할 수 있음을 제시한다.
AI.motivation: 세포 내 액적상 분리가 무생물계와 다른 물리원리를 가질 가능성이 있고, 양적 규칙성이 불명확한 가운데 광합성 탄소 고정 향상을 담당하는 피레노이드를 통해 생체 시스템에서의 정량적 원리를 밝히려 함.
AI.method: 문헌검토 및 이론적 통합: 반응-확산 모델로 구획 구조와 촉매 성능 연결, 연성물질(soft matter) 이론으로 분자상호작용과 응집체 조립 설명, 현대 실험법으로 예측 검증.
AI.result: 피레노이드 기능은 소수의 유효 전달·반응 과정으로 기술 가능하며, 응집체 조립은 분자 설계인자와 열역학적 제약으로 이해될 수 있음. 실험-이론 상호작용을 통해 정량적 검증이 가능해짐.
AI.conclusion: 피레노이드는 촉매적 구획화·분자 자기조직화·생체계에서의 유효 물리서술 출현을 연구하기 위한 강력한 모델 시스템임.

title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Discovery and Clinical Validation of Deep Radiomic Signatures in Tumor Classification
summary: Imaging signatures are quantitative features extracted from medical images that provide clinically meaningful information for tumor diagnosis, characterization, prognosis, and treatment planning. Although deep learning has shown great potential for imaging signature discovery, its limited interpretability remains a major barrier to clinical adoption. Existing approaches often achieve high predictive performance but provide little biological insight into the identified signatures. We propose a unified framework for interpretable imaging signature discovery by integrating deep learning based segmentation, explainable classification, and radiomic analysis. A robust segmentation model is first used to accurately delineate tumors, followed by a Grad-CAM guided pipeline that identifies diagnostically important regions as candidate imaging signatures. A mutual information based adaptive thresholding strategy enables patient-specific signature extraction. The resulting signatures are validated using a downstream deep learning classification model, while radiomic features extracted from the signature regions are evaluated with traditional machine learning models and interpreted using SHAP to identify the most discriminative biomarkers. The proposed framework is evaluated on the public BUSI breast ultrasound, KiTS renal CT, and BraTS brain tumor datasets, as well as a private UF Health renal CT cohort. Compared with conventional whole-tumor radiomics, the proposed signature-based approach achieves improved discriminative performance while providing greater biological interpretability. By converting deep learning attention into reproducible quantitative imaging biomarkers, this framework offers an interpretable and reproducible solution for non-invasive tumor characterization and imaging biomarker discovery.

AI.tldr: A unified framework that combines robust segmentation, Grad-CAM guided candidate-region extraction with mutual-information adaptive thresholding, and radiomic+explainable modelling to turn deep learning attention into reproducible imaging signatures; shows improved discriminative performance vs whole-tumor radiomics on multiple public and a private dataset.
AI.motivation: Deep learning can discover predictive imaging signatures but lacks biological interpretability and reproducibility necessary for clinical adoption; need methods that produce quantitative, explainable biomarkers from model attention.
AI.method: 1) Train a robust segmentation model to delineate tumors. 2) Use Grad-CAM from a classifier to highlight diagnostically important regions. 3) Apply mutual-information-based adaptive thresholding to extract patient-specific signature regions. 4) Validate signatures with a downstream deep-learning classifier; extract radiomic features from signature regions and evaluate with ML models. 5) Use SHAP to interpret radiomic feature contributions.
AI.result: Signature-based approach yielded improved discriminative metrics compared with conventional whole-tumor radiomics across BUSI, KiTS, BraTS, and a private UF Health renal CT cohort. Radiomic features from signature regions identified discriminative biomarkers via SHAP, suggesting greater biological interpretability.
AI.conclusion: Converting model attention to reproducible quantitative imaging biomarkers produces more interpretable and better-performing signatures than whole-tumor radiomics, but further external validation, robustness checks, and biological correlation are needed for clinical translation.

title: Development and application of a multiphase Lagrangian structure function model in anisotropic turbulence
summary: The energetic response of inertial particles to turbulent flow motions is important for both a fundamental understanding of the multi-phase dynamics at play, and for applications such as reduced-order models of particle dispersion processes, and their two-way coupled effects onto the flow phase. Numerous studies focus on the energetics of ensembles of particles in homogeneous isotropic turbulence, where the influence of flow anisotropy (such as that provided by boundary conditions, or other external forcing) is not considered a priori. In this work, we investigate the role of flow anisotropy on the Eulerian scale-wise particle phase energetics in a turbulent wall bounded flow for settling inertial Lagrangian particles. By using coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian direct numerical simulations at moderate Reynolds number, we aim to unravel the complex dependency of the scale-wise particle energetics on the turbulence intensity, particle inertia, and particle settling. In particular, we focus on how the developing anisotropy of the underlying turbulent flow (derived from the presence of the wall) is donated to the particle phase, and how particle inertia and settling preserve this large scale anisotropy into the formally isotropic scale range of the flow. We derive an exact (but unclosed) conservation law for the particle phase energetics at arbitrary scale, and use an asymptotic argument to help elucidate our DNS data. We discuss the relative changes to the quasi-streamwise and vertical components of the fluctuating particle field, and finish by discussing the implications of anisotropic non-local effects for more general flows, and the implications for continuum models of inertial settling Lagrangian particles.

AI.tldr: 벽면에 의해 유발된 비등방성이 입자 위상에 전달되고, 입자 관성 및 침강이 큰 스케일의 비등방성을 작은(형식상 등방성인) 스케일까지 보존시킨다는 것을 DNS와 스케일별 에너지 보존식으로 보여준다.
AI.motivation: 동역학적 다상 유체 문제에서 난류-입자 상호작용의 스케일별 에너지 분포는 기본과 응용(입자 확산 모델링, 양방향 결합 영향 등) 모두에 중요하나, 기존 연구는 등방성 난류에 집중되어 벽 등으로 인한 유동 비등방성의 입자 위상 전파는 충분히 다뤄지지 않았다.
AI.method: 중간 레이놀즈 수 채널 흐름에서 Eulerian–Lagrangian 직접수치시뮬레이션(DNS)을 사용해 정착하는 관성 입자를 추적하고, 임의 스케일에서의 입자 에너지에 대한 정확(비닫힘) 보존식을 유도한 뒤 점근 해석을 이용해 DNS 결과를 해석한다.
AI.result: 벽에 의해 유발된 유동 비등방성이 입자 위상으로 전달되며, 입자 관성 및 침강이 대형 비등방성을 형성·유지하여 통상적으로 등방성으로 간주되는 소규모 스케일까지 비등방성이 잔존한다. 준-스트림방향과 수직 성분의 변화를 정량화하고 비국소적 효과의 중요성을 제시한다.
AI.conclusion: 스케일-종속 비등방성 및 비국소적 전달은 연속체(레이저-유체) 모델의 닫힘 가정에 중요한 함의를 가지며, 입자 에너지 보존식의 항들을 모델링할 때 이러한 효과를 고려해야 한다.

title: PTCOG Treatment Efficiency Subcommittee Risk Assessment Report on Patient-Specific Quality Assurance
comment: PTCOG Treatment Efficiency Subcommittee White Paper; certified version accepted June 10, 2026; 135 pages, 28 figures; will be hosted on the official PTCOG website and assigned a DOI by Elsevier
summary:
Patient-specific quality assurance (PSQA) in pencil beam scanning proton therapy (PBS-PT) is often treated as a purely technical verification task. This PTCOG Treatment Efficiency Subcommittee White Paper instead frames PSQA as a workflow-embedded risk-control strategy and asks how different PSQA approaches reshape the same clinical risk landscape. Using a generic PBS-PT process-driven Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (pFMEA), 44 validated PSQA-relevant failure modes across 20 process steps were scored under a common no-PSQA baseline and three PSQA pathways: measurement-based PSQA, log file-based PSQA, and independent secondary dose calculation.
  A staged mathematical formalism separates preparatory data-stage effects, method-specific full-stage verification, cumulative endstate effects, and a Data-to-Cum bridge that quantifies additional verification benefit on the baseline scale. In this expert-scored, baseline-anchored model, log file-based PSQA produced the largest cumulative workflow-level risk-score reduction, followed by measurement-based PSQA and independent secondary dose calculation. The ranking is not a winner-takes-all rule or probability-calibrated risk estimate; instead, each method shows distinct risk-control strengths in different workflow regions.
  The White Paper therefore supports a risk-informed hybrid PSQA architecture, where log file-based PSQA, measurement-based PSQA, and independent secondary dose calculation are assigned to the workflow segments in which their signatures are strongest. It provides a transparent, semi-quantitative, stage-resolved framework for institutions seeking to evaluate, implement, or evolve PSQA in PBS-PT and emphasizes that log file-based PSQA must itself be supported by validated and governed log data and treatment records.

AI.tldr: PSQA를 PBS-PT 워크플로 내 위험저감 전략으로 재정의하고, pFMEA 기반으로 측정기반, 로그파일 기반, 독립 2차계산 세 경로가 동일한 위험지형을 어떻게 재구성하는지 비교함. 로그파일 기반이 누적적 위험 저감에서 가장 큰 효과를 보였으나 각 방법은 워크플로의 다른 구간에서 강점이 있어 하이브리드 적용을 권고함.
AI.motivation: PSQA를 단순한 기술검증이 아닌 워크플로 임베디드 위험관리 수단으로 재프레이밍하고, 서로 다른 PSQA 방식들이 임상적 위험지형에 미치는 영향과 최적 조합을 이해하려는 목적.
AI.method: PBS-PT 공정 주도 pFMEA를 사용하여 20개 프로세스 단계에 걸친 44개 검증된 실패 모드를 설정. 기준선(PSQA 없음)과 세 가지 PSQA 경로(측정기반, 로그파일 기반, 독립 2차계산)를 공통 스케일로 전문가 점수화. 데이터단계·전단계 검증·누적 종단효과·Data-to-Cum 브리지를 분리하는 단계별 수학적 형식화 적용.
AI.result: 전문가 점수화 모델에서 로그파일 기반 PSQA가 누적 워크플로 수준의 위험점수 감소를 가장 크게 보였고, 다음이 측정기반, 그 다음이 독립 2차계산. 각 방법은 워크플로의 다른 영역에서 고유한 위험제어 강점을 가짐.
AI.conclusion: 리스크-정보 기반 하이브리드 PSQA 아키텍처를 권장하며, 각 방법을 자신이 강한 워크플로 세그먼트에 배치할 것을 제안. 로그파일 기반 PSQA는 검증되고 거버넌스된 로그 데이터 및 치료기록으로 뒷받침되어야 함; 기관들이 PSQA를 평가·도입·진화시키는 데 유용한 반정량적 단계해상 프레임워크를 제공함.

title: Energetic Protection, Monotonicity and Switching Far from Equilibrium
summary: At equilibrium, the ratio of two steady-state probabilities is a Boltzmann factor, set by a free-energy difference. Such ratios are the natural, normalization-independent readouts of both thermodynamics and information processing, and are often used as a measure of fidelity in biophysical systems. What becomes of these ratios once a system is driven from equilibrium, where the Boltzmann factor no longer holds? Representing Markov processes as graphs and their steady states as averages over a distribution on spanning trees, the \emph{arboreal distribution}, we track the ratio $π_i/π_j$ under driving along \emph{energetic edges}, where detailed balance is broken, relative to its equilibrium value. Our central finding is that a chosen ratio can stay exactly locked to its equilibrium value arbitrarily far from equilibrium, a phenomenon we call \emph{energetic protection}, whenever an algebraic equality between spanning-tree weights holds. Just as detailed balance constrains rates around cycles, energetic protection constrains weights across trees, providing a new mechanism for robustness against fluctuations in the driving force, such as variations in ATP concentration. Away from this equality, single-edge driving collapses the response onto two arboreal coefficients and forces it to be monotonic, so nonmonotonic single-edge control is impossible at any strength. With two energetic edges, protection and monotonicity combine into a \emph{thermodynamic switch} that holds a function at its equilibrium value for as long as desired and releases it sharply. Equilibrium is known for the limits it places on information processing. We show that new constraints, both no-go principles and exact invariances, survive far from equilibrium. These results reveal how the localization of energy expenditure governs the functional logic of nonequilibrium systems in physics and biology.

AI.tldr: 비평형에서 확률비 π_i/π_j가 여전히 평형값에 '잠김'될 수 있음(energetic protection). 단일 에너지 엣지 구동은 반응을 단조화하고 두 개의 에너지 엣지로는 '열역학적 스위치'를 만들 수 있음. 스패닝 트리 가중치(arboreal distribution)에 대한 대수적 등식이 보호 조건을 규정한다.
AI.motivation: 평형에서 확률비는 볼츠만 인자로 고정되어 있으며, 이는 열역학·정보처리·생체 신뢰성의 표준 측정값이다. 비평형 구동 시(예: ATP 농도의 변화) 이 비율들이 어떻게 변하는지, 어떤 제약(또는 불변성)이 남아있는지 규명하는 것이 목적이다.
AI.method: 마르코프 과정을 그래프로 표상하고 정상분포를 스패닝 트리 분포(arboreal distribution)의 평균으로 표현. 상세평형을 깨는 '에너지적 엣지'에 대해 π_i/π_j의 변화 추적. 스패닝 트리 가중치 사이의 대수적 등식을 도출·분석하고 단일·이중 에너지 엣지의 경우를 해석하여 단조성·보호·스위치 동작을 수학적으로 증명.
AI.result: (1) 특정 스패닝 트리 가중치들의 대수적 등식이 성립하면 π_i/π_j는 임의로 강한 비평형 구동에서도 평형값에 정확히 고정(energetic protection). (2) 등식이 성립하지 않으면 단일 에너지 엣지 구동은 응답을 두 개의 arboreal 계수로 축소하고 항상 단조적—비단조적 제어는 불가능. (3) 두 에너지 엣지에서는 보호와 단조성이 결합되어 '열역학적 스위치'를 구성, 기능을 평형값에 길게 고정했다가 급격히 방출 가능. (4) 이로써 평형에서 알려진 정보제약 외에 비평형에서도 불변성·no-go 원리들이 존재함을 제시.
AI.conclusion: 에너지 소비의 국지화(localization)가 비평형 시스템의 기능 논리를 규정한다. 스패닝 트리 가중치의 대수적 관계가 실험적·설계적 관점에서 안정성·정밀도(예: 생체 분자의 정확성)에 대한 새로운 보호 메커니즘과 제약을 제공한다.

title: Model Confidence-Guided Multi-Image Fusion of Fundus Images for Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
summary:
Purpose: Early screening for eye diseases is critical in low- and middle-income countries where access to care is limited. We investigate whether a confidence-guided, multi-image diabetic retinopathy diagnosis framework can integrate image filtering with confidence-aware predictions for reliable screening at capture.
  Methods: We develop a multi-image fusion method that aggregates retinal views to improve confidence and balanced accuracy. Our method uses confidence to identify unreliable predictions, prompting retakes when needed.
  We compare: (1) a cascaded image-quality and disease diagnosis pipeline using a single image per patient, (2) confidence-based prediction, and (3) our confidence-based multi-image fusion pipeline. All methods are evaluated using a RETFoundGreen backbone on the mBRSET (n = 1,234) and BRSET (n = 7,599) datasets.
  Results: At 70% coverage, our method achieves 91% balanced accuracy on mBRSET and 97% on BRSET, improvements of ~12% and ~6%, respectively, over cascade filtering. The image-quality cascade reaches sensitivities of 61% on mBRSET and 86% on BRSET, whereas our framework reaches 94% and 96%, respectively, at 50% coverage.
  Conclusions: Human-annotated quality labels are weakly associated with diagnostic performance, and confidence-based filtering consistently outperforms image quality-based cascaded pipelines.
  Translational Relevance: Using confidence-based multi-image fusion, patients receive more reliable predictions, reducing incorrect diagnoses during screening. The lightweight backbone and single inference pass per image make the framework compatible with low-latency mobile screening systems in resource-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 신뢰도 기반 다중 이미지 융합 프레임워크는 이미지 선택(재촬영 유도)과 신뢰도 활용 예측으로 단일 이미지 기반 품질-질병 파이프라인보다 선별검사에서 더 높은 균형 정확도와 민감도를 보였습니다. 저비용 모바일 스크리닝에 적합하도록 경량 백본과 단일 패스 추론을 사용합니다.
AI.motivation: 저·중소득국에서 안과 접근성이 제한된 상황에서 조기 안질환 선별의 신뢰성과 실용성을 높일 필요가 있습니다. 사람 주석 기반 화질 라벨은 진단 성능과 약하게 연관되어 있어, 진단 신뢰도를 직접 활용한 필터링·융합 방법이 유용할 수 있다는 가정을 검증합니다.
AI.method: 여러 망막 뷰를 신뢰도 기반으로 융합해 예측 신뢰와 균형 정확도를 향상시킵니다. 각 이미지에 대해 RETFoundGreen 백본으로 단일 패스 추론을 수행해 신뢰도(uncertainty)를 산출하고, 신뢰도가 낮으면 재촬영을 유도합니다. 비교 대상은(1) 이미지 품질 기반 캐스케이드(단일 이미지), (2) 단일 이미지 신뢰도 기반 예측, (3) 제안한 신뢰도 기반 다중 이미지 융합이다. mBRSET, BRSET 데이터셋에서 평가했습니다.
AI.result: 70% 커버리지에서 제안법은 mBRSET에서 균형 정확도 91%(캐스케이드 대비 ≈+12%), BRSET에서 97%(≈+6%)를 기록했습니다. 품질 기반 캐스케이드는 민감도 61%(mBRSET), 86%(BRSET)에 그쳤고, 제안법은 50% 커버리지에서 각각 94%, 96%의 민감도를 달성했습니다.
AI.conclusion: 사람 주석 화질 라벨은 진단 성능을 잘 대변하지 못하며, 신뢰도 기반 필터링이 화질 기반 캐스케이드보다 일관되게 우수합니다. 다중 이미지 융합은 재촬영 유도와 결합해 선별검사의 잘못된 진단을 줄이고, 모바일 환경에 적합한 실용성을 제공합니다.

title: Transferable inference of turbulence models for urban flows with the Parameter-Regularised Ensemble Kalman Filter
summary: The accurate simulation of urban flow is key to designing building ventilation, understanding cities' micrometeorology, and predicting pollutant dispersion. Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) simulations are a common modelling approach for simulating urban flow, but their accuracy depends on the closure model and its parameters. These parameters are inferred from benchmark cases, but they are not necessarily suitable for realistic urban environments, which involve different physical mechanisms. This is referred to as the transferability problem of RANS urban modelling. The objective of this work is to propose a robust Bayesian method to {sequentially} infer RANS parameters for urban flow modelling. Key to the approach is the mathematical derivation of the parameter-regularised ensemble Kalman filter (PR-EnKF), which is the analytical solution of the data assimilation problem for the sequential parameter estimation. The cost functional is regularised using the prior knowledge on the turbulence parameters, thereby ensuring that the Bayesian updates remain within physical ranges. The parameters are first inferred on an isolated building, and then transferred to three cases of increasing complexity: (i) a high-rise building, (ii) a multi-building array, and (iii) the Shinjuku district urban environment. Results show that the PR-EnKF achieves faster convergence, reducing parameter uncertainty by an order of magnitude and reconstruction errors by up to 50%. Because of the regularisation, the PR-EnKF selectively updates the most important parameters. This work enables robust large-scale urban flow simulation whilst reducing the computational overhead of model optimisation for urban planning and air quality assessment.

AI.tldr: Proposes a parameter-regularised ensemble Kalman filter (PR-EnKF) for sequential Bayesian inference of RANS turbulence parameters in urban flow. Regularisation enforces physical prior bounds. Parameters inferred on an isolated building and transferred to more complex configurations; method claims faster convergence, order-of-magnitude uncertainty reduction, and up to 50% error reduction.
AI.motivation: RANS closure parameters tuned on benchmarks often fail to transfer to realistic urban geometries; need a robust, Bayesian sequential estimation method that respects physical parameter ranges.
AI.method: Mathematical derivation of PR-EnKF as an analytical solution to sequential parameter estimation. Regularised cost functional incorporates priors on turbulence parameters. Parameters are inferred sequentially on simple to complex urban cases.
AI.result: PR-EnKF shows faster convergence than unregularised methods, reduces parameter uncertainty by ~10x, and lowers reconstruction errors up to 50%. Regularisation leads to selective updating of influential parameters.
AI.conclusion: PR-EnKF enables more robust, computationally efficient large-scale urban RANS simulations by reducing model-optimization overhead and improving parameter transferability.

title: Comparison of accuracy and efficiency of three-dimensional discrete ordinates and voxel-scoring Monte Carlo dose calculations for an $I^{125}$ seed
comment: This unpublished manuscript reports research performed in 2001-2003. While the Ms. was edited and revised in 2026 for clarity, the data, including the 8 figures and 5 tables, are unchanged. The manuscript consists of 17 full-text pages, including title page, abstract, and references
summary: This study compares the efficiency of three-dimensional deterministic discrete-ordinates calculations and voxel-based Monte Carlo simulations of the dose distribution around a model 6702 125I seed in a homogeneous water phantom. The computational efficiency of the PARTISN multigroup discrete ordinates neutral particle transport code is compared to the most efficient Monte Carlo voxel-scoring computer code available to us at the time, which was developed specifically for brachytherapy. The difficulties of such comparisons from the fact that the Monte Carlo and discrete ordinates method exhibit stochastic and systematic errors of different origins. To address this problem, we propose a parametric model for separating the systematic and stochastic error components of each method. Based on this model, a procedure for assessing efficiency of the two methods is proposed consisting of the following steps: (i)-apply the developed error model to evaluate the accuracy of each method relative to unbiased and accurate Monte Carlo point estimator calculations in the same phantom geometry; (ii)-develop systematic and stochastic error criteria which specifies equivalent accuracy of the two methods; and (iii) determine the relative efficiency of two methods by taking the ratio of CPU times required to satisfy these accuracy criteria. This process demostrates that three-dimensional PARTISN discrete ordinate simulations is a factor-of-two more efficient than our voxel-based Monte Carlo code in the 125I energy range. This suggests that discrete ordinates simulations can support efficiency competitive with that of Monte Carlo in three-dimensional geometries and can serve as an efficient and accurate dose-calculation engine in treatment planning for brachytherapy and other treatment modalities utilizing low energy photon fields.

AI.tldr: 세 문장 요약: 연구는 125I 시드 주변 선량 계산에서 PARTISN(다중군 유한각법)이 본 논문에서 사용한 voxel 기반 몬테카를로 코드보다 약 2배 효율적임을 보고한다. 이를 위해 체계적·확률적 오차를 분리하는 모수적 오차 모델을 제안하고, 동일 정확도 조건에서 CPU 시간비로 효율을 비교한다. 결론은 저에너지 광자장(125I)에서는 결정방정식(Discrete ordinates)이 몬테카를로와 경쟁 가능한 효율을 가질 수 있다는 것.
AI.motivation: 임상 브라키테라피 계획에서 정확하면서 계산 효율이 높은 선량 계산기가 필요하다. 몬테카를로는 일반적으로 정확하지만 계산비용이 크고, 결정방정식법은 결정적·격자 기반으로 효율적일 수 있으나 시스템적 오차가 있다. 서로 다른 오차 성격 때문에 공정한 효율 비교가 어려워 이를 해결할 모델이 필요하다.
AI.method: 1) PARTISN 다중군 유한각법 코드와 자체 개발한 voxel-점수기 기반 몬테카를로 코드를 동일한 균질 물 팬텀과 125I 시드 모델에 적용. 2) 모수적 오차 모델을 도입해 각 방법의 체계적 오차(모델·격자·에너지군 근사 등)와 확률적 오차(통계적 잡음)를 분리. 3) 무편향 고정확도 몬테카를로 점추정치와 비교하여 정확도를 평가하고, 동일 정확도 기준을 정한 뒤 CPU 시간비로 상대 효율 산정.
AI.result: 제시한 절차에 따라 비교한 결과, 125I 에너지 범위에서 3D PARTISN 유한각법 계산이 해당 voxel-몬테카를로 코드보다 약 2배 더 효율적임.
AI.conclusion: 저에너지 광자장(125I)에서는 적절히 설정된 유한각법이 몬테카를로에 비해 경쟁력 있는 계산 효율을 제공할 수 있으며, 브라키테라피 등 치료계획에서 실용적 대안이 될 수 있다.

title: Deep Learning-Based Characterization of Detonation-Cell Size Distributions in Soot-Foil Records
summary: The geometric size and regularity of detonation cells are key physical parameters for characterizing detonation waves. Traditional manual measurement of soot foils is time-consuming and subjective, while existing computer vision techniques often exhibit poor generalization on real experimental images with high noise, blurred boundaries, and severe overlapping. To address this, we propose a novel method for automated recognition and high-order feature extraction of detonation cells based on deep learning instance segmentation (Mask R-CNN). By constructing a custom heterogeneous dataset (numerical simulations and physical experiments) and integrating transfer learning, the model achieves accurate pixel-level mask prediction within highly noisy flow fields. Results indicate high pixel-level agreement in benchmark validations and strong robustness against noise in complex real-world soot foils. Predicted average cell sizes agree well with manual measurements, yielding relative errors under 2% and 3.5% for regular and irregular conditions, respectively. Sensitivity ablation experiments confirm the model's scale adaptability and guided the establishment of a standardized preprocessing paradigm for appropriate image patching. Overcoming the limitation of extracting only global average sizes, this model achieves automated tracking of the transient spatial evolution of cell sizes along the propagation direction. Furthermore, it quantitatively extracts high-order regularity features, such as the irregularity index (RI) and standard deviation of cell deflection angles, demonstrating consistency with theoretical expectations. The proposed method enhances the efficiency and objectivity of statistical analysis, providing a powerful data extraction tool for experimental and numerical soot foils.

AI.tldr: 제안된 방법은 Mask R-CNN 기반 인스턴스 분할을 사용해 잡음 많고 경계가 불분명한 소트 포일에서 폭발 셀(detontation cell)을 자동 인식하고 고차 특징(셀 크기, 불규칙성 지수, 편각 표준편차 등)을 추출한다. 시뮬·실험 혼합 데이터셋과 전이학습, 표준화된 전처리(이미지 패칭)를 통해 실험 이미지에 강인한 성능을 보이며 평균 셀 크기 오차가 규칙/비규칙 조건에서 각각 <2% 및 <3.5%이다.
AI.motivation: 수동 소트 포일 측정은 시간 소모적이고 주관적이며, 기존 컴퓨터 비전 기법은 실험 이미지의 고잡음·경계 흐림·심한 중첩에 대해 일반화 성능이 낮아 자동화된, 신뢰성 있는 픽셀 수준 분할 및 고차 통계 추출 기법이 필요하다.
AI.method: Mask R-CNN을 기반으로 인스턴스 분할 모델을 채택하고, 수치 시뮬레이션과 실제 실험 이미지를 혼합한 이종 데이터셋을 구성하여 전이학습으로 초기화했다. 적절한 전처리(이미지 패칭 표준화)를 확립하고 민감도 추적 실험(스케일 적응성 등)으로 모델 파라미터와 패칭 전략을 최적화했다. 예측 마스크로부터 개별 셀의 크기, 불규칙성 지수(RI), 편각 표준편차 등 고차 특징을 계산하고 시간-공간 축을 따라 셀 크기 변화를 추적했다.
AI.result: 벤치마크 검증에서 높은 픽셀 수준 일치도(정량적 지표는 본문 참조), 실제 소트 포일 잡음에 대한 강인성 확보. 평균 셀 크기 측정은 수동 측정과 비교해 규칙 조건에서 상대오차 <2%, 비규칙 조건에서 <3.5%. 스케일 민감도 실험으로 패칭 규칙 확립. RI 및 편각 표준편차 같은 고차 통계가 이론적 기대와 일관됨.
AI.conclusion: 제안된 방법은 소트 포일의 통계 분석을 효율적·객관적으로 수행할 수 있는 자동화 도구를 제공하며, 픽셀 수준 분할과 고차 특성 추출을 통해 실험 및 수치 자료에서 신뢰성 있는 계량 정보를 얻을 수 있다.

title: SCoReT: Super-Resolution Compression and Reconstruction of Turbulent Flows
summary: High-fidelity simulations of the Navier--Stokes equations (NSE) generate massive amounts of data, motivating the need for efficient compression and reconstruction strategies for turbulent flows. At the same time, reconstructing flow fields from sparse measurements while retaining spectral content, turbulence statistics, and coherent structures remains a major challenge. This work investigates two complementary paradigms for turbulent flow reconstruction: supervised reconstruction and physics-informed reconstruction, in the context of transition to turbulence induced by three-dimensional distributed roughness elements. We introduce a vorticity-augmented supervised approach and a physics-informed approach, implemented through a partially assisted compressible PINN formulation based on the three-dimensional unsteady compressible Navier--Stokes equations. Reconstruction performance is evaluated at different sparsity levels using instantaneous velocity fields, mean-squared error, energy spectra, Reynolds stresses, turbulent kinetic energy, and Q-criterion isosurfaces. Rather than establishing a universal winner, the present study characterises the respective strengths, limitations, and operating regimes of these two approaches. The results indicate that at lower sparsity levels, the vorticity-augmented supervised model yields the lowest reconstruction error, recovers key statistical and spectral features, and enables substantial data compression. The PINN shows potential to reconstruct turbulent flows from sparse measurements without high-resolution labels and exhibits comparatively stable held-out extrapolation behaviour at higher sparsity. These results suggest the potential of combining data-driven and physics-informed learning for flow data compression and physics-informed reconstruction of turbulent flows from sparse data.

AI.tldr: Two reconstruction paradigms for roughness-induced transition flows are compared: a vorticity-augmented supervised model (best at low sensor sparsity) and a partially-assisted compressible PINN (better at high sparsity and label-free reconstruction); study maps their strengths and suggests hybrid approaches.
AI.motivation: High-fidelity Navier–Stokes simulations produce huge datasets; need for compression and reconstruction from sparse measurements while preserving spectra, statistics, and coherent structures for turbulent flows.
AI.method: Introduce a supervised reconstruction augmented with vorticity information and a physics-informed approach implemented as a partially-assisted compressible PINN based on 3D unsteady compressible NSE. Evaluate reconstruction at varying sparsity using instantaneous fields, MSE, energy spectra, Reynolds stresses, TKE, and Q-criterion isosurfaces.
AI.result: At low measurement sparsity, the vorticity-augmented supervised model yields lowest reconstruction error and recovers key statistics and spectra; PINN can reconstruct without high-resolution labels and shows more stable extrapolation at higher sparsity. No single winner; complementary regimes identified.
AI.conclusion: Combining data-driven supervised models and physics-informed PINNs appears promising for compressing flow data and reconstructing turbulent flows from sparse data; each method has distinct operating regimes and trade-offs.

title: GALOSH: Blind, Training-Free Denoising of Raw Bayer and sRGB Images by Parallel-Friendly Local Shrinkage
summary: Classical training-free denoisers such as BM3D and non-local means owe much of their strength to search: content-dependent block matching whose memory traffic and data-dependent control flow parallelize poorly and preclude fixed-latency implementations. Learned denoisers reach the highest quality, but they need training data, degrade outside their training domain (which we also observe), and carry per-pixel compute budgets that effectively require a GPU. We present GALOSH (Generalized Anscombe LOcal SHrinkage), a redesign of training-free denoising that removes the search entirely and aims at multi-domain coverage, speed, and quality at once: a blind per-image Poisson-Gaussian noise fit, a generalized Anscombe transform, a two-pass local Walsh-Hadamard shrinkage of luminance, and a luminance-guided local regression of chrominance -- two deliberately different operators for the two perceptually different noise components, each with its own strength control. Every stage is local, data-independent, and regular -- the same computation graph for every pixel of every image. One core serves two domains: raw Bayer mosaics and sRGB/YUV images. On four real-noise benchmarks (SIDD Medium and RawNIND, raw and sRGB) GALOSH is consistently the strongest among the tested blind, training-free methods -- surpassing BM3D- and NLM-family baselines even when those are given an oracle noise level -- and approaches trained networks on raw data while remaining below in-domain trained networks at high ISO in sRGB. Being search-free makes it fast: 7x-650x faster than the DL baselines on the same GPU at full benchmark size, and the only strong method in the comparison that also runs practically on plain CPUs. The fixed, data-independent structure is designed to map naturally onto fixed-point and streaming hardware, supported by an operation-count analysis and a working INT16 fixed-point realization.

AI.tldr: GALOSH is a training-free, search-free denoiser combining a blind Poisson–Gaussian fit, a generalized Anscombe transform, a two-pass local Walsh–Hadamard luminance shrinkage, and luminance-guided local chrominance regression to deliver multi-domain, fast, and hardware-friendly denoising competitive with learned methods.
AI.motivation: Classical search-based denoisers (BM3D, NLM) rely on content-dependent block matching that prevents fixed-latency, streaming, or fixed-point implementations; learned denoisers need training data, degrade out-of-domain, and are computationally heavy. The paper aims to design a denoiser that is training-free, search-free, fast, multi-domain, and amenable to fixed-point/hardware realization.
AI.method: Per-image blind fit to Poisson–Gaussian noise followed by a generalized Anscombe variance-stabilizing transform; separate operators for luminance and chrominance: two-pass local Walsh–Hadamard shrinkage for luminance and luminance-guided local regression for chrominance. All stages are local, data-independent, and regular (same computation graph per pixel). Supports raw Bayer mosaics and sRGB/YUV inputs. Includes operation-count analysis and an INT16 fixed-point implementation.
AI.result: On four real-noise benchmarks (SIDD Medium and RawNIND, raw and sRGB) GALOSH outperforms other blind, training-free methods (even BM3D/NLM with oracle noise levels), approaches trained-network performance on raw data, remains below in-domain trained networks at high ISO in sRGB, and is 7×–650× faster than deep-learning baselines on the same GPU while also running practically on CPUs.
AI.conclusion: GALOSH demonstrates that a carefully designed, search-free, training-free pipeline can achieve strong multi-domain denoising quality with fixed, data-independent computation suited to fixed-point and streaming hardware, offering a compelling trade-off between quality, speed, and implementability.

title: A dual--continuum phase-field model for hydraulic fracturing: Viscosity-dominated regime and fluid lag
summary: The phase-field model regularizes sharp fractures into a diffuse representation, blurring the boundary between the fracture and the intact material. This blurring makes it difficult to capture distinct domain processes in hydraulic fracturing, where Reynolds flow governs the fracture and Darcy flow describes the surrounding porous matrix. Consequently, the blurred delineation artificially smears the pressure field across the fracture--matrix interface, which is acceptable in toughness-dominated hydraulic fracturing regimes where pressure drops within the fracture are negligible. However, in viscosity-dominated regimes, typically for actual subsurface injections due to high injection rates, the fluid pressure drops more drastically, and the fluid front may even lag behind the propagating fracture tip, a phenomenon that a smeared pressure field cannot capture. Despite its relevance, the viscosity-dominated regime has not been addressed by any existing phase-field models to date, likely due to its numerical instability. In this study, we propose a dual--continuum phase-field model based on double-porosity microporomechanics that explicitly separates mesoscale crack pressure from micropore pressure. The framework provides a variationally consistent formulation alongside phase-field--dependent poroelasticity. To ensure the numerical stability of the hydromechanical coupling, a fixed-stress split scheme is modified for two independent fluid pressures, while a variational inequality constraint is applied to reproduce fluid lag. Verified against the closed-form solutions in toughness-dominated, viscosity-dominated, and early-time transitional regimes, the model accurately captures complex fluid flow behavior and transient fluid lag within the fracture, and opens a new frontier for applying phase-field models to realistic viscosity-dominated hydraulic fracturing.

AI.tldr: Phase-field 기반 파괴 모델의 흐릿한 균열-매트릭스 경계 때문에 점성지배(hydraulic fracturing)의 큰 압력강하와 유체 지연을 포착하기 어렵다. 본 논문은 이 문제를 해결하기 위해 이중-연속체(double-continuum)와 이중-다공성(double-porosity) 마이크로포로메카닉스를 결합한 이중-압력(균열/미세공극) 위상을 제안하고, 변분적 일관성, 수정된 고정응력 분할(specific fixed-stress split) 및 유체지연을 강제하는 변분부등식으로 안정적 결합을 이룬다. 닫힌형 해와의 검증에서 난류·점성·전이 영역을 잘 재현하고 과도 유체 지연을 포착한다.
AI.motivation: 전통적 phase-field fracture는 균열과 매트릭스 사이를 확산시켜 경계가 흐려지므로, 균열 내 Reynolds 흐름과 매트릭스 내 Darcy 흐름이라는 서로 다른 연속체 물리(특히 점성지배 조건에서의 큰 압력강하와 유체전단 현상)를 정확히 표현하지 못한다. 따라서 실제 지하 주입 조건에서 중요한 점성지배(regime)를 다루기 위한 모델이 필요하다.
AI.method: 이중-연속체 위상-필드 모델을 도입하고, 이중 압력(메조스케일 균열압력과 마이크로공극압력)을 분리한 double-porosity microporomechanics 프레임을 구축했다. 변분적 능동성(variational consistency)을 유지하면서 위상-필드에 의존하는 포로엘라스틱성(poroelasticity)을 도입했고, 수치적 안정성을 위해 두 개의 독립 압력을 처리하는 수정된 fixed-stress 분할법을 사용했다. 유체 지연 현상은 variational inequality constraint로 구현했다.
AI.result: 털프-도메인(취성/점성/전이) 닫힌형 해와의 검증에서 모델은 균열 내 압력강하, 유체 전진(front)과 균열선의 분리(지연), 과도거동 등을 정확히 재현하였다. 수치적으로 안정적이며 점성지배 상황에 적용 가능함을 보였다.
AI.conclusion: 점성지배 수압파쇄를 대상으로 한 phase-field 접근의 새로운 분기(open frontier)를 열었으며, 복잡한 유체–탄성체 상호작용과 유체 지연을 안정적으로 재현할 수 있는 실용적 모델을 제시한다.

title: GLOW-FDG: Generalized cancer LesiOn Whole-body segmentation model for $^{18}$F-FDG-PET/CT
summary: Whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography combined with computed tomography is widely used in cancer care, but manual lesion delineation is slow, subjective, and difficult to scale. We present GLOW-FDG, an open-source artificial intelligence model for whole-body cancer lesion segmentation in fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography and computed tomography. The model was trained on 1,563 scans spanning multiple cancer types and evaluated on 185 external scans from independent institutions. Across breast cancer, nonmetastatic and oligometastatic lung cancer, head and neck cancer, and metastatic melanoma, GLOW-FDG consistently outperformed publicly available benchmark models in lesion detection, while reducing false positives and maintaining strong segmentation accuracy. Quantification of total tumor burden and total lesion glycolysis was robust across cohorts, and performance approached the variability observed between expert radiation oncologists. These results support GLOW-FDG as a generalizable tool for automated cancer segmentation and quantitative imaging biomarker extraction in whole-body imaging.

AI.tldr: GLOW-FDG는 1,563건의 전신 FDG PET/CT로 학습하고 185건의 외부 검증에서 기존 공개 벤치마크보다 병변 검출 성능이 우수하고 위양성은 감소시키며 분할 정확도는 유지한 오픈소스 전신 암 병변 분할 모델이다. 총 종양 부담(TTB)과 총 병변 글리코리시스(TLG) 정량도 전문가 간 변이 범위에 근접했다.
AI.motivation: 전신 FDG PET/CT에서 병변을 수동으로 윤곽화하는 작업은 느리고 주관적이며 대규모 적용이 어렵다. 자동화된, 범용적이고 검증된 분할 도구가 필요하다.
AI.method: 다양한 암종을 포함한 1,563건의 학습용 스캔으로 모델을 학습하고, 서로 다른 기관의 185건 외부 검증 세트에서 기존 공개 벤치마크들과 비교 평가했다. 평가 항목은 병변 검출, 위양성률, 분할 정확도 및 TTB/TLG 정량성이다.
AI.result: 여러 암종에서 GLOW-FDG가 병변 검출에서 일관되게 우수했고 위양성은 줄였으며 분할 정확도는 강하게 유지되었다. TTB와 TLG 정량이 코호트 전반에서 견고했고 성능은 전문가 방사선종양학자 간 변이에 근접했다.
AI.conclusion: GLOW-FDG는 전신 영상에서 자동 병변 분할과 정량적 영상 바이오마커 추출을 위한 범용적이고 일반화 가능한 도구로서 유망하다.

title: A comprehensive Darcy-type law for viscoplastic fluids: II. Rheology & topology
summary: We extend our recently proposed framework (Chaparian, Phys. Rev. Fluids 10(9) 093301, 2025) for deriving a Darcy-type law governing viscoplastic flows through porous media to incorporate more applied aspects. In particular, the present work considers a more realistic rheological model (i.e. Herschel-Bulkley, describing the shear-thinning nature of practical yield-stress fluids) along with a wider range of porous media topologies. In our earlier work, the problem was addressed by decomposing the full Bingham number spectrum (representing the ratio of the yield stress of the fluid to the characteristic viscous stress) into three main regions: (i) low Bingham numbers (weak yield stress limit) corresponding to Newtonian flow, (ii) high Bingham numbers (strong yield stress limit) representing yield limit/plastic flow, and (iii) intermediate Bingham numbers (transition regime). By deriving theoretical models for the two asymptotic limits of the spectrum and combining them, we obtained a Darcy-type law applicable across the entire range of Bingham numbers. In contrast to our original work, where the weak yield stress limit reduces to a Newtonian flow, here, this limit instead follows a power-law asymptote that captures the shear-thinning dominated behaviour of Herschel-Bulkley fluids. In the present study, we derive a scaling to address this limit. The framework is further generalised to incorporate a broader spectrum of porous media topologies, enabling a systematic assessment of how pore geometry influences the resulting macroscopic flow law. The proposed framework provides a unified theoretical basis for predicting yield-stress fluid transport through complex porous media and establishes a pathway towards finding macroscopic models applicable to a wide range of natural systems and industrial processes.

AI.tldr: This paper generalizes a previous framework to derive Darcy-type laws for yield-stress fluids by replacing the Newtonian weak-yield asymptote with a Herschel–Bulkley power-law limit and by extending porous-topology coverage; it produces a unified macroscopic law valid across Bingham-number regimes.
AI.motivation: Practical yield-stress fluids are shear-thinning (Herschel–Bulkley), and porous media in applications have diverse pore geometries; extending a Darcy-like upscaling that covers full Bingham-number spectrum and realistic rheology/topologies addresses a gap between theory and practice.
AI.method: Decompose the full Bingham-number spectrum into three regimes (weak, intermediate, strong). Derive asymptotic macroscopic laws in the weak (now Herschel–Bulkley power-law) and strong (yield-limit/plastic) limits, obtain scalings for the Herschel–Bulkley weak limit, generalize pore-scale analysis to a wider class of pore geometries, and combine asymptotic results into a composite Darcy-type law applicable across Bingham numbers.
AI.result: A Darcy-type relation valid across the full Bingham-number range for Herschel–Bulkley fluids, with the weak-yield asymptote showing power-law dependence (shear-thinning), and dependence of macroscopic parameters on pore geometry characterized systematically.
AI.conclusion: The study provides a unified theoretical basis to predict transport of shear-thinning yield-stress fluids through complex porous media and a pathway to derive macroscopic models for many natural and industrial systems.

title: Cross-Modal Fusion of OCT and OCT angiography enface for Improved Diagnostics of Diabetic Retinopathy
summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of vision impairment worldwide, highlighting the need for accurate and accessible screening tools. Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) provides high-resolution structural information of the retina, whereas OCT angiography (OCTA) offers complementary vascular information that is highly relevant for DR diagnosis. In this study, we propose a cross-modal fusion of OCT B-scans with single-channel en face OCTA using a bidirectional cross-modal attention network for automated DR classification. Two independent datasets, OCT500 and UIC, comprising 730 subjects in total, were utilized to evaluate performance under within-dataset, combined-dataset, and cross-dataset generalization settings. A ConvNeXt V2 model trained solely on OCT images served as the unimodal baseline. In addition to ground-truth (GT) OCTA, we explored the use of translated (TR) OCTA generated from OCT scans, eliminating the requirement for dedicated OCTA hardware. Experimental results demonstrate that cross-modal fusion consistently outperforms unimodal OCT classification across all evaluation scenarios. Fusion with GT OCTA improved classification accuracy and discriminative performance, while TR OCTA achieved comparable or superior results in most settings. Furthermore, TR OCTA improved sensitivity and cross-dataset generalization, indicating enhanced robustness to domain shifts. These findings demonstrate that attention-based OCT-OCTA en face fusion provides clinically meaningful improvements for DR detection and suggest that computationally generated OCTA can serve as a practical, low-cost alternative to hardware-acquired OCTA, enabling broader deployment of high-performance retinal screening systems in resource-limited clinical environments.

AI.tldr: OCT B-scan과 (실제 또는 변환된) en face OCTA를 양방향 교차-모달 어텐션으로 융합하면 당뇨병성 망막병증 분류 성능이 향상되며, 변환된 OCTA는 하드웨어 OCTA를 대체할 수 있다는 결과를 제시함.
AI.motivation: DR 검진의 정확성 향상과 OCTA 하드웨어 접근성 제한 문제를 해결하기 위해, 구조 정보(OCT)와 혈관 정보(OCTA)를 결합하고 하드웨어 없이도 OCTA를 얻는 방법을 모색함.
AI.method: OCT B-scan과 단일 채널 en face OCTA를 양방향 교차-모달 어텐션 네트워크로 융합. ConvNeXt V2 기반 OCT 단일모달 베이스라인과 비교. GT OCTA와 OCT로부터 생성된 TR OCTA를 모두 평가. 데이터셋은 OCT500과 UIC(총 730명)이며 within-, combined-, cross-dataset 설정에서 검증.
AI.result: 융합 방법이 단일 모달(=OCT)보다 모든 시나리오에서 우수. GT OCTA 융합이 분류 성능을 향상시켰고, TR OCTA는 대부분의 경우에 동등하거나 더 나은 성능을 보였음. TR OCTA는 민감도 개선 및 데이터셋 간 일반화 향상에 기여함.
AI.conclusion: 어텐션 기반 OCT–OCTA en face 융합은 임상적으로 의미 있는 DR 검출 성능 개선을 제공하며, 계산적으로 생성된 OCTA는 저비용 대안으로 실무 적용 가능성을 가짐.

title: Mechanisms of lift generation and drag invariance by asymmetric surface roughness on a sphere
summary: The mechanisms governing transverse force generation on a sphere with asymmetric dimpled roughness are investigated using wall-resolved large eddy simulation at $Re=U_\infty d/ν=100{,}000$ for $k/d=0.004$, $0.006$, and $0.008$. Previous experiments by Sudarsana et al. (2024) showed that asymmetric roughness can generate lift comparable to the peak Magnus force on a rotating sphere while leaving the mean drag nearly unchanged. The present simulations reproduce this behavior and reveal the coupled mechanisms responsible for lift generation and drag invariance. Pressure-force decomposition shows that asymmetric dimples redistribute the streamwise pressure contribution between the upstream and downstream hemispheres with little change in net drag, while producing a finite transverse pressure imbalance that generates lift. A Fourier decomposition further shows that pressure drag is governed primarily by the axisymmetric pressure component, whereas lift is governed by the non-axisymmetric component. The dimples also produce distinct transition pathways on the two hemispheres: the dimpled side undergoes near-wall transition before separation, delaying separation non-uniformly to $φ_s\sim105^\circ - 125^\circ$, while the smooth side separates in a laminar state at $φ_s\sim80^\circ$. The resulting pressure asymmetry drives sidewash from the smooth to the dimpled side, which rolls up into a counter-rotating streamwise vortex pair that amplifies wake deflection beyond that expected from separation-angle differences alone. These results show that lift generation arises from the coupled interaction of asymmetric transition, non-uniform separation, pressure-driven sidewash, and coherent wake reorganization.

AI.tldr: 비대칭 딤플 표면을 가진 구에서의 횡력(리프트) 생성 메커니즘을 LES로 조사함. 비대칭 딤플은 축대칭 압력 성분에는 거의 영향을 주지 않아 항력은 거의 변하지 않지만, 비축대칭 압력 불균형을 만들어 횡력을 유도함. 비대칭 전이와 비균일 분리는 사이드워시와 스트림 방향 코어스의 소용돌이 쌍을 발생시켜 와크 편향을 증폭함.
AI.motivation: 실험(2024년 Sudarsana 등)이 비대칭 표면 거칠기가 회전 구의 Magnus력과 유사한 리프트를 생성하면서 평균 항력은 거의 변하지 않는다는 것을 보였음. 그 메커니즘(전이, 분리, 압력 분포, 와이크 구조의 상호작용)을 수치적으로 규명할 필요가 있어 LES를 수행함.
AI.method: 벽-해상도 대형 에디 시뮬레이션(WRLES) 수행, Re=100,000, 상대 거칠기 k/d=0.004,0.006,0.008. 압력-력 분해(반구별 스트림방향 압력 기여) 및 푸리에(각방위 성분) 분해로 축대칭/비축대칭 성분 분석. 유동 전이·분리 지점과 와크 구조(스트림방향 소용돌이 쌍) 관찰.
AI.result: 시뮬레이션은 실험 결과 재현: 평균 항력 변화는 작고 유의한 횡력이 발생. 압력 분해에서 항력은 주로 축대칭 성분이 지배, 리프트는 비축대칭 성분이 지배. 딤플이 있는 쪽은 근벽 전이가 분리 이전에 발생하여 분리가 지연(φ_s≈105–125°), 매끄러운 쪽은 층류 상태에서 일찍 분리(φ_s≈80°). 이로 인한 압력 비대칭이 사이드워시를 만들고, 이는 반회전 스트림방향 소용돌이 쌍으로 말려들어가 와크 편향을 증폭함.
AI.conclusion: 비대칭 딤플이 생성하는 리프트는 단일 원인(분리각 차이)이 아니라 전이·비균일 분리·압력 비대칭에 의한 사이드워시와 코히어런트 와크 재조직의 결합된 상호작용에 의해 발생함.

title: FedProIn: Mitigating Client Drift for Learnable Prototypes in Federated Medical Imaging
summary: Federated learning (FL) is severely hindered by statistical heterogeneity due to variations in scanners, acquisition protocols, and patient populations. Such non-IID data induces client drift during local optimization, leading to unstable convergence and suboptimal global models when parameter-based aggregation is applied. We propose a prototype-based, influence-aware federated learning framework (FedProIn) that uses multiple learnable class prototypes to capture shared semantic structures across heterogeneous clients. We introduce feature divergence loss and prototype contrastive loss to mitigate client drift by decomposing it into feature drift and prototype drift. In addition, we propose a normalized influence aggregation strategy that adaptively weights client prototypes according to their contribution to the global representation, reducing the impact of biased or low-quality updates. Experimental results on two publicly available medical datasets, HAM10000 and Matek-19, demonstrate that FedProIn achieves accuracies of (83.5% IID, 81.1% non-IID) on HAM10000 and (96.2% IID, 95.8% non-IID) on Matek-19, respectively, outperforming existing baselines in both conditions. Our code is available at https://github.com/harsh-kmr/FedProIn.

AI.tldr: FedProIn은 다중 학습 가능한 클래스 프로토타입과 영향력 기반 정규화 집계를 도입해 비IID로 인한 클라이언트 드리프트를 분해(특징 드리프트·프로토타입 드리프트)·완화하고 의료 데이터에서 성능을 개선한 프로토타입 기반 연합학습 프레임워크이다.
AI.motivation: 연합학습에서 스캐너·획득 프로토콜·환자 분포 차이로 인한 통계적 이질성(비IID)은 로컬 최적화 중 클라이언트 드리프트를 유발해 파라미터 기반 단순 평균 집계 시 불안정한 수렴과 성능 저하를 초래한다.
AI.method: 각 클래스에 대해 다수의 학습 가능한 프로토타입을 도입해 이질적 클라이언트 간의 공유된 의미 구조를 포착한다. 클라이언트 드리프트를 특징 드리프트와 프로토타입 드리프트로 분해하고, 이를 완화하기 위해 feature divergence loss와 prototype contrastive loss를 설계한다. 추가로 클라이언트 프로토타입을 글로벌 표현에 대한 기여도로 가중하는 normalized influence aggregation 전략을 적용해 편향되거나 저품질 업데이트의 영향을 줄인다.
AI.result: HAM10000에서 IID 조건 83.5%, non-IID 81.1%, Matek-19에서 IID 96.2%, non-IID 95.8%의 정확도를 기록하며, 제시된 베이스라인들보다 우수한 성능을 보였다.
AI.conclusion: 프로토타입 기반 표현과 영향력 가중 집계의 결합으로 비IID 환경에서 클라이언트 드리프트를 효과적으로 완화해 연합학습의 안정성과 성능을 향상시킨 실용적 접근법이다.

title: PhysMiner: An Agentic AI Framework for Discovering Turbulence Physics
summary: Uncovering the physical mechanisms of turbulent flows remains a fundamental challenge in fluid mechanics. In particular, conventional velocity-gradient analysis methods suffer from shear contamination, which hinders accurate identification of the dominant physical mechanisms. This study presents PhysMiner, an automated framework integrating the triple decomposition method of the velocity gradient tensor with large language model-driven reasoning for turbulence-physics discovery. The triple decomposition module automatically decomposes flow fields into rigid rotation, pure shearing, and normal straining components, enabling statistical analysis, contour visualization, vortex-line extraction, and threshold-insensitive vortex identification while eliminating shear contamination. These automated capabilities are validated across five benchmarks, ranging from canonical configurations to complex engineering flows. A discover-physics agent combines flow statistics, spatial structures, and literature-derived knowledge to perform pattern recognition and physical inference, while a review Agent iteratively validates physical consistency to ensure reliable conclusions. A continuously evolving Triple Decomposition Library accumulates statistical knowledge from successfully analyzed flows, enabling cross-case comparison and progressive enhancement of inductive capability. The complete PhysMiner pipeline is validated end-to-end on the periodic hill flow, where the framework autonomously generates turbulence modeling recommendations and derives an improved subgrid-scale model with superior Reynolds-stress predictions. PhysMiner is open to the public and establishes a foundation for long-term collaborative advancement in automated turbulence-physics discovery.

AI.tldr: PhysMiner는 속도구배의 삼중분해(triple decomposition)를 통해 회전·전단·정압성분을 분리하고, 대형언어모델(LLM) 기반의 추론 에이전트를 결합해 난류 물리 발견을 자동화한 프레임워크이다. 여러 벤치마크에서 검증하고, periodic hill 케이스에서 개선된 하위격자 모델을 도출했다.
AI.motivation: 전통적 속도구배 분석은 전단 오염(shear contamination)으로 인해 지배적 물리메커니즘의 정확한 식별이 어렵다. 자동화·지식집적을 통해 재현가능하고 확장 가능한 난류 물리 발견 방식을 제시하려 한다.
AI.method: (1) 속도구배의 삼중분해로 강체회전(rigid rotation), 순전단(pure shearing), 정상응변(normal straining) 성분 분리; (2) 통계·등고선·와류선·경계감지 등 자동화 도구; (3) LLM 기반 Discover-Physics 에이전트와 Review 에이전트로 패턴인식·물리추론·검증 수행; (4) 사례를 누적하는 Triple Decomposition Library로 교차비교·점진학습.
AI.result: 5개 벤치마크에서 자동화 기능 검증. Periodic hill 전 범위 검증에서 자율적으로 난류모델 권고 및 개선된 하위격자(SSG) 모델 도출, Reynolds-응력 예측 개선 보고.
AI.conclusion: PhysMiner는 전단오염 제거를 기반으로 한 자동화된 난류물리 발견 플랫폼을 제시하며, 공개된 라이브러리·파이프라인으로 장기적 협업 발전의 토대를 마련한다.

title: Non-Line-of-Sight imaging using raster scanning at NIR wavelength
summary: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging is an emerging technique with transformative potential, enabling the visualization of hidden objects through indirect light reflection. This paper presents a NLOS imaging method operating in the near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths, specifically employing a raster scanning technique with a pan-tilt device. The NIR laser, operating at a wavelength of 808 nm and an output power of 500 mW, illuminates a hidden target occluded by an obstacle. The imaging process involves three bounces: the laser beam first strikes a relay wall, then reflects off the hidden target, returns to the relay wall, and subsequently reaches the NIR camera. This study systematically evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed method across three distinct targets, demonstrating the capability to recover high-quality images from non-line-of-sight scenarios. The obtained images of the hidden targets are compared with their ground truth images, and the error in the obtained images is assessed based on the criteria of Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE).

AI.tldr: 본 논문은 NIR(808 nm, 500 mW) 레이저와 팬-틸트 기반 래스터 스캔을 이용해 3회 반사(릴레이 벽→타깃→릴레이 벽→카메라) 경로로 비가시선(NLOS) 이미지를 복원하고, 세 가지 타깃에 대해 MSE/RMSE로 오차를 평가한 연구이다.
AI.motivation: 가려진 물체를 간접 반사를 통해 시각화하여 NLOS 이미징의 실용적 가능성을 확립하려는 목적이다. NIR 대역과 래스터 스캔, 팬-틸트 구성을 통해 비교적 간단한 장치로 숨은 타깃을 복원하려 함.
AI.method: 808 nm, 500 mW NIR 레이저를 팬-틸트로 래스터 스캔하여 릴레이 벽에 빛을 투사한다. 빛은 릴레이 벽→숨은 타깃→릴레이 벽→NIR 카메라의 3회 반사 경로로 들어와 측정된다. 획득된 데이터로 타깃 영상을 복원하고, 복원 영상과 원본(ground truth)을 MSE/RMSE로 비교한다.
AI.result: 세 가지 타깃에 대해 고품질의 NLOS 복원 영상을 얻었으며, 복원 결과의 오차를 MSE 및 RMSE로 정량화하였다.
AI.conclusion: 제안된 NIR 래스터 스캔 방식이 비가시선 영상 복원에 실용적 가능성을 보였으나, 논문에는 재현성·비교실험·복원 알고리즘·노이즈·스캔 파라미터에 대한 상세 기술이 부족하다.

title: Quadrature-Aware Complex-Linear Neural Operator for Boundary-to-Field Prediction in Resonant Acoustics
summary: Repeated prediction of acoustic fields from spatially distributed boundary excitation is computationally expensive when each source realization requires a new wave simulation. This work introduces a quadrature-aware complex-linear boundary operator (CLBO) that maps complex normal velocity on a vibrating surface to complex pressure at receiver locations. The model couples learned source and receiver basis functions through an explicit complex surface-quadrature contraction, so the boundary excitation enters linearly by construction. This preserves complex superposition, homogeneity, and zero response to zero excitation, while representing the source through coordinates, normals, and quadrature weights rather than a fixed flattened input vector. Reference data were generated using a verified three-dimensional multiple-relaxation-time (MRT) lattice Boltzmann solver and stored in a solver-agnostic boundary-to-field format. CLBO was compared with a fixed-sensor complex DeepONet under matched case splits and optimization settings, with additional tests of structural consistency, receiver-coordinate interpolation, source discretization, source-family holdout, label efficiency, physics-informed ablations, unseen source mixtures, and computational cost. Across five training seeds, CLBO achieved a mean complex relative field error of 0.184 +/- 0.00771, compared with 0.367 +/- 0.00742 for DeepONet. Its measured source-superposition error was 1.31 x 10^-7, and its mean error on newly simulated mixed-source cases was 0.237, compared with 0.415 for DeepONet. Inference was 1.83 x 10^4 faster than the reference calculation for the reported query size. These results show that enforcing the known complex-linear boundary-to-field structure improves physical consistency and generalization under distributed acoustic excitation.

AI.tldr: Introduces a quadrature-aware complex-linear boundary operator (CLBO) that maps complex normal velocity on vibrating surfaces to complex pressure at receivers using learned source/receiver bases coupled via explicit surface-quadrature contraction. CLBO enforces linearity, preserves superposition, and outperforms a fixed-sensor complex DeepONet in field-error (0.184 vs 0.367), source-superposition error (~1.3e-7), mixed-source generalization (0.237 vs 0.415), and inference speed (~1.83e4× faster).
AI.motivation: Repeatedly simulating wave fields for many boundary-source realizations is expensive. A surrogate that preserves known linear structure from boundary excitation to measured fields can reduce cost while improving physical consistency and generalization.
AI.method: Construct a complex-linear operator that represents the source via coordinates, normals, and quadrature weights; learn source and receiver basis functions; couple them through an explicit complex surface-quadrature contraction so excitation enters linearly by construction. Train using data from a verified 3D MRT lattice Boltzmann solver stored in a solver-agnostic boundary-to-field format. Compare with DeepONet under matched conditions and run multiple ablations and tests.
AI.result: Across five seeds, CLBO achieved mean complex relative field error 0.184±0.00771 vs DeepONet 0.367±0.00742. Source-superposition error was 1.31×10^-7. Mean error on unseen mixed-source cases was 0.237 vs 0.415 for DeepONet. Inference speed was ~1.83×10^4 faster than the reference solver.
AI.conclusion: Embedding known complex-linear boundary-to-field structure (via quadrature-aware design) yields better physical consistency, generalization to novel source mixtures, and large computational savings compared with a generic data-driven DeepONet surrogate.

title: MambaRefine-CD: MambaVision with Region-Boundary Temporal Refinement
summary: Binary change detection in remote sensing requires both complete changed-region localization and accurate boundary delineation. We present MambaRefine-CD, a region-boundary temporal refinement framework built on a shared MambaVision encoder. The proposed D-RBI module constructs temporal evidence from paired features, absolute differences, and signed differences, then separates it into region and Sobel-conditioned boundary streams. Region features are enhanced with CRAM-lite and decoded by an adaptive receptive-field FPN, while the finest boundary stream guides a bounded residual refinement of the coarse prediction. Experiments on DSIFN-CD and WHU-CD show strong changed-class F1 and IoU under verified evaluation settings, and ablations support the contribution of signed temporal evidence and the full region-boundary refinement pipeline.

AI.tldr: MambaRefine-CD는 공유 MambaVision 인코더를 기반으로 하는 시공간(temporal) region-boundary 정제 프레임워크로, 부호화된 시차(absolute 및 signed difference)와 페어 피처를 이용해 region 스트림과 Sobel로 조건화된 boundary 스트림을 분리 처리하고, CRAM-lite와 적응 수용영역 FPN으로 region을 향상·디코딩하며, 경계 스트림으로 coarse 예측을 bounded residual 방식으로 정제한다. DSIFN-CD와 WHU-CD에서 높은 changed-class F1/IoU를 보고하고, ablation으로 signed evidence와 전체 파이프라인의 기여를 입증했다.
AI.motivation: 원격탐사 변화탐지에서 변화 영역의 완전한 위치 탐지와 경계의 정확한 윤곽 추출을 동시에 달성하는 것이 중요하므로, region과 boundary를 별도 스트림으로 취급해 상보적으로 정제하는 프레임워크가 필요하다.
AI.method: 공유 MambaVision 인코더로 입력 시점 쌍을 인코딩한 뒤 D-RBI 모듈에서 paired features, absolute difference, signed difference로부터 temporal evidence를 구성한다. 이 evidence를 region 스트림과 Sobel-conditioned boundary 스트림으로 분리한다. Region은 CRAM-lite로 강화되고 adaptive receptive-field FPN으로 디코딩된다. 가장 세밀한(boundary) 스트림은 coarse 예측에 bounded residual 정제를 적용해 최종 예측을 얻는다.
AI.result: DSIFN-CD 및 WHU-CD 데이터셋에서 검증된 평가 설정 하에 높은 changed-class F1과 IoU를 달성했다. Ablation 실험은 signed temporal evidence와 region-boundary 정제 파이프라인의 전체 구성요소가 성능 향상에 기여함을 보여준다.
AI.conclusion: region과 boundary를 분리해 각기 다른 신호(절대·부호 차분, Sobel 경계)를 활용하고, 경계 기반 잔차 정제로 coarse 예측을 보정하는 접근은 변화영역 정밀도와 경계 정확도를 동시에 개선하며, 제안한 구성요소들이 상호 보완적으로 성능 향상에 기여한다.

title: Generalizable turbulence closures across bluff-body shapes by PINN-based solver-agnostic training
summary: Data-driven turbulence closures are usually calibrated by inverse methods that place a CFD solver inside the optimization loop, tying the learned model to a particular discretization and requiring every intermediate iterate to converge. We instead train closures inside a physics-informed neural network (PINN): the RANS residual is imposed by automatic differentiation, making the inverse problem mesh-free, differentiable, and solver-agnostic. Because no forward solve runs during training, only the final closure must be solver-stable, arbitrary neural closures are admitted without deriving adjoints, and iterative solver costs are avoided. Each constitutive hypothesis trains in minutes on a single GPU, enabling rapid screening of closure forms. We develop four closures: three model the Reynolds stress on a tensor basis with built-in realizability (a local map, a non-local model transporting turbulent kinetic energy, and the same with a learned length scale l), while a fourth models the Reynolds force F = -\nabla \cdot τdirectly, free of realizability constraints. The closures are trained across six 2D bluff-body wakes at Re = 10^4 and deployed frozen in a finite-element solver. Coupled stability is enhanced by input-gradient smoothing and a Lipschitz constraint. We assess closures in-sample and under a strict leave-one-shape-out (LOSO) protocol. All four improve substantially on a steady SST k-ωbaseline. The learned-length-scale stress closure is most accurate on stress fields, while transporting kinetic energy is decisive for generalization. Notably, the force model generalizes best and attains the lowest out-of-sample error on mean velocity and drag (LOSO drag error ~8.5%). Finally, we show these closures can be efficiently trained on PIV data, enabling data-driven modeling for geometries intractable for DNS.

AI.tldr: RANS-closure를 PINN으로 학습해 메쉬-무관·미분가능·무-솔버 훈련을 실현하고, 4종의 신경망 기반 폐쇄식(3개의 텐서-기반+1개의 힘 모델)을 2D 블러프 바디 와크에 대해 학습·검증해 기존 SST k-ω 기준선보다 성능 향상과 우수한 일반화(특히 힘 모델)를 보였다.
AI.motivation: 전통적 데이터 기반 난류 폐쇄 모델은 최적화 루프 안에 CFD 솔버를 넣어 특정 격자·솔버에 묶이고 중간 반복마다 완전 수렴을 요구해 계산비·제약이 큼. 이를 극복하기 위해 메쉬-무관·솔버-무관하게 RANS 잔차를 PINN으로 강제해 역문제를 자동미분으로 풀려는 동기.
AI.method: RANS 잔차를 자동미분으로 PINN 손실에 포함시켜 격자·솔버 의존성을 제거. 전방 해석 없이 학습해 임의 신경망 폐쇄식을 허용. 네 가지 폐쇄식 제안: (1) 텐서 기초의 지역 맵, (2) 난류운동에너지(k)를 수송하는 비국소 모델, (3) 학습된 길이스케일 l을 추가한 모델, (4) τ의 발산(힘 F=-∇·τ)을 직접 모델링한 힘 모델. 6개의 2D 블러프 바디(Re=10^4)에서 학습 후 유한요소 솔버에 고정(동결)하여 배치. 안정성 향상을 위해 입력-기울기 스무딩과 Lipschitz 제약 적용.
AI.result: 모든 제안된 폐쇄식이 정적 SST k-ω 기준선보다 평균적으로 우수. 응력장 기준에서는 학습된 길이-스케일 모델이 최고, 일반화(LOSO)에는 k 수송이 결정적. 전체적으로 힘 모델이 가장 잘 일반화하며 평균 속도·항력에서 최저 오차(LOSO 항력 오차 약 8.5%)를 달성. PIV 데이터로도 효율적 학습 가능함을 시연.
AI.conclusion: PINN 기반 학습은 솔버·메쉬에 구애받지 않는 빠른 폐쇄식 탐색을 가능케 하고, 힘-기반 폐쇄식이 실무적 일반화·성능 측면에서 유망함. 실험 데이터 적용도 현실적이며, 추가 검증(3D·다중 Re·안정성·물리성 보장)이 뒤따라야 함.

title: CompressedVQA-AEV: Full-Reference and No-Reference Quality Assessment Models for Asymmetric Encoded Videos
comment: CompressedVQA-AEV-FR achieves first place in the FR track of QoMEX 2026 Grand Challenge
summary: This report presents our solutions to the QoMEX 2026 Grand Challenge on Video Quality Assessment for Asymmetric Encoded Videos, comprising a full-reference (FR) model, CompressedVQA-AEV-FR, and a no-reference (NR) model, CompressedVQA-AEV-NR. The FR approach leverages a Swin-B backbone to extract multi-stage similarity statistics between reference and distorted videos for quality prediction. For the NR setting, our model employs complementary frame-level encoders based on SigLIP2 and Swin-B, followed by temporal mean pooling and cross-fold ensembling to estimate perceptual quality without reference data. Our CompressedVQA-AEV-FR achieves first place in the FR track of QoMEX 2026 Grand Challenge, while CompressedVQA-AEV-NR secures fourth place in the NR track, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed models. The code is available at https://github.com/sunwei925/CompressedVQA-AEV.

AI.tldr: QoMEX 2026 챌린지에서 제안된 두 모델: FR 모델(CompressedVQA-AEV-FR)은 Swin-B를 이용해 참조와 왜곡 영상 간의 다중 단계 유사성 통계를 추출하여 품질을 예측하고, NR 모델(CompressedVQA-AEV-NR)은 SigLIP2와 Swin-B 기반의 보완적 프레임 인코더, 시계열 평균 풀링 및 교차-폴드 앙상블을 통해 참조 없이 품질을 추정함. FR 트랙 1위, NR 트랙 4위.
AI.motivation: 비대칭 압축(Asymmetric encoded)으로 인한 영상 품질 열화를 정확히 평가하기 위해, 참조가 있는 경우와 없는 경우 모두에 대해 강건하고 경쟁력 있는 VQA 모델을 개발하기 위함.
AI.method: FR: Swin-B 백본으로 다중 단계 특징들 사이의 유사성 통계(아마도 유사도 맵/거리/통계량)를 계산해 품질 예측. NR: SigLIP2와 Swin-B 기반의 두 프레임 레벨 인코더를 병렬로 사용해 보완적 표현을 얻고, 프레임 단위 예측을 시간 평균 풀링한 뒤 교차-폴드 앙상블로 최종 품질 점수를 산출.
AI.result: CompressedVQA-AEV-FR이 QoMEX 2026 FR 트랙 1위 달성, CompressedVQA-AEV-NR가 NR 트랙 4위 달성으로 방법의 유효성 입증.
AI.conclusion: 단일 모델 구성과 간단한 시계열 처리(평균 풀링) 및 앙상블 전략으로도 챌린지 상위권 성능 달성 가능. 코드 공개로 재현성 제공.

title: U3DWind: A Low Altitude Wind Field Dataset and Benchmark for Urban Air Mobility
summary: Urban Air Mobility (UAM) requires reliable assessment of low-altitude wind hazards, because winds, gusts, and building-induced turbulence have been recognized as critical factors affecting vehicle stability, route feasibility, vertiport siting, and airspace management. While wind-tunnel experiments, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), multiscale downscaling, reduced-order models, and UAV planning datasets have advanced wind-aware analysis, public resources for data-driven, city-scale UAM planning remain limited in geographic coverage, scenario diversity, vertical extent, building realism, and task-oriented benchmarking. To address this gap, we introduce U3DWind, a building-resolved low-altitude wind-field dataset generated using our GPU-accelerated Lattice Boltzmann Method--Large-Eddy Simulation (LBM-LES) framework for rapid urban flow simulation. U3DWind covers five megacities in China: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. It contains 720 simulations, with 16 inflow directions, three reference wind speeds, and three seasonal atmospheric scenarios (annual, summer, and winter) for each city. At a 10 m grid resolution, the dataset provides three-dimensional three-component (3D3C) velocity, turbulent kinetic energy (TKE), flow density, and fluid--solid masks. To support operationally relevant evaluation, we further define five baseline tasks: wind-field prediction, sparse-sensor wind-field reconstruction, site wind-exposure ranking, airworthiness wind-compliance risk scoring, and noise propagation modeling. As a multi-city, building-resolved 3D urban wind-field dataset, U3DWind enables systematic evaluation of wind-induced impacts in low-altitude traffic scenarios and provides an open benchmark for urban airspace management and data-driven high-fidelity urban flow simulation.

AI.tldr: U3DWind는 GPU 가속 LBM-LES로 생성한 건물 해상도 3D 도시 저고도 풍장(dataset)으로, 중국 5개 대도시에서 720개 시뮬레이션(16방향×3속도×3계절)을 10 m 격자로 제공한다. 3성분 속도, TKE, 밀도, 유체-고체 마스크를 포함하며 풍장 예측·복원·노출 순위·비행 적합성 리스크·소음 전파 등 5개 베이스라인 과제를 제안한다.
AI.motivation: UAM 운영·설계에는 저고도 도시 풍장의 정밀한 정보가 필수지만, 기존 공개 자원은 지리적 범위·시나리오 다양성·수직 범위·건물 현실성·작업 지향 벤치마크 면에서 한계가 있어, 대규모 데이터 기반 평가용 공개 데이터셋이 필요하다.
AI.method: 저자들은 GPU 가속 Lattice Boltzmann Method 기반 Large-Eddy Simulation(LBM-LES) 프레임워크를 사용해 도시 건물해상도 시뮬레이션을 빠르게 수행했다. 다섯 개 도시(베이징·상하이·광저우·선전·홍콩)에서 각기 16 유입 방향, 3 기준 풍속, 3 계절 시나리오로 총 720개 케이스를 생성하고, 10 m 격자에서 3D3C 속도, TKE, 유동 밀도, 유체-고체 마스크를 저장했다.
AI.result: 데이터셋은 도시 규모의 저고도 3D 풍장 정보를 제공하며, 다섯 가지 작업(풍장 예측, 희소 관측 복원, 사이트 노출 순위, 항공 적합성 리스크 스코어링, 소음 전파 모델링)을 위한 벤치마크를 제안한다. 공개적으로 사용 가능한 데이터로 UAM 관련 평가·연구를 촉진한다.
AI.conclusion: U3DWind는 다중 도시·건물해상도·3차원 도시 풍장 데이터의 공개 벤치마크로서 UAM 운영·공간 계획 및 데이터 기반 고충실도 도시 유동 시뮬레이션의 체계적 평가를 가능하게 한다.

title: Discovering shared interpretable operations in image compression autoencoders
summary: With the increasing adoption of deep learning for applications such as image compression, improvements in the rate-distortion trade-off have been achieved at the cost of increasingly larger and more opaque ''black-box'' models. Autoencoders are among the most widely used architectures for this task; however, without a clear understanding of their internal behavior, these models tend to grow in complexity to achieve more performance gains. In this paper, we investigate whether universal behaviors can be detected from the internal operations of bias-free autoencoders through Jacobian analysis. If such behaviors exist, they may be extracted to design low-complexity image compression models inspired by high-complexity deep learning architectures.

AI.tldr: 검증된 보편적 행위를 찾아 저복잡도 이미지 압축 모델 설계에 활용하려는 연구. 편향(bias) 없는 오토인코더 내부의 야코비안 분석을 통해 공통 패턴을 탐색한다.
AI.motivation: 딥러닝 기반 이미지 압축은 성능이 향상되었지만 모델이 커지고 복잡해져 해석성과 효율성이 떨어짐. 내부 행동에서 재사용 가능한 보편적 특성을 찾아 단순하면서도 성능 좋은 모델을 설계하고자 함.
AI.method: 편향이 제거된 오토인코더들을 대상으로 네트워크 내부 연산의 야코비안(입력-출력 미분 행렬) 분석을 수행하여 스펙트럼/특이값/주성분 등 공통적 거동을 식별. 발견된 특성으로부터 저복잡도 설계 원칙을 도출.
AI.result: (초록에는 구체적 결과가 없음) 야코비안 분석을 통해 보편적 행위가 있는지 여부를 조사함. 이를 바탕으로 고복잡도 모델에서 영감을 받은 저복잡도 압축기 설계 가능성을 제시.
AI.conclusion: 오토인코더 내부의 야코비안 분석으로 보편적 패턴을 찾아내면 복잡한 블랙박스 모델에서 얻은 통찰을 단순 모델로 이전해 효율적 이미지 압축기를 설계할 수 있다는 가능성을 제시한다.

title: Near-real-time, meter-scale 3D urban wind modeling for low-altitude micrometeorology: numerical verification of a GPU-accelerated lattice Boltzmann framework
summary: This study presents a near-real-time, meter-scale three-dimensional urban wind simulation framework for low-altitude flight events in complex urban meteorological environments. It reconstructs high-resolution wind fields by combining sparse observations with efficient microscale flow modeling. The framework integrates lattice Boltzmann method large-eddy simulation (LBM-LES), high-fidelity urban morphology reconstruction that explicitly resolves real building details, and observation-driven boundary assimilation into a rapid end-to-end pipeline for realistic urban domains. Multi-site Doppler lidar measurements from dense urban Guangzhou, China, are used for evaluation. The system reconstructs three-dimensional wind fields at 5 m resolution over kilometer-scale domains within minutes. Robustness and accuracy are tested through controlled observation reduction, independent validation against withheld lidar stations, and sensitivity analyses of grid resolution and precursor domain extent. Results show stable reproduction of vertical wind structures and key local flow features under complex morphology and limited observations, providing a scalable pathway for near-real-time urban wind reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 도심 저고도 비행을 위해 희소 관측과 고효율 미소스케일 유동모델을 결합해 도심의 5 m 격자 해상도, km-규모 도메인 풍장을 수 분 내 재구성하는 LBM-LES 기반의 실시간 유사 시스템을 제시. 광저우 다중 도플러 라이다로 검증했고 관측 감소·격자 민감도 검사에서 수직 구조와 국지 유동특징을 안정적으로 재현함.
AI.motivation: 저고도(무인기 등) 도시 비행에 필요한 실제적, 고해상도 도시 풍장 정보를 실시간(또는 준실시간)으로 얻기 위해, 제한된 관측만으로도 미터급 3차원 풍장을 재구성하는 방법 필요.
AI.method: 라티스 볼츠만 방식의 대-와류 시뮬레이션(LBM-LES) 채택, 실제 건물 상세를 해상도로 명시적으로 복원한 고충실도 도시 지형 적용, 다중 지점 도플러 라이다 관측을 이용한 경계/관측 동화(assimilation)로 엔드-투-엔드 파이프라인 구현.
AI.result: 광저우 도심 데이터로 검증하여 km-규모 도메인에서 5 m 격자 풍장을 수 분 내 재구성. 관측 수 축소 실험·독립성 검증·격자·전구간(precursor) 민감도 분석에서 수직구조와 주요 국지 흐름 특징을 안정적으로 재현함.
AI.conclusion: 복잡한 도시 형상과 제한된 관측하에서도 준실시간으로 고해상도 3D 풍장을 재구성할 수 있는 확장 가능한 방법론을 제시함.

title: Reduced-complexity Adaptive Loop Filtering via Input-dependent Graph Filters
summary: Adaptive Loop Filtering is an important tool for suppressing compression artifacts in modern video codecs. In the enhanced compression model (ECM), a software test model used for experimenting with video coding tools beyond Versatile Video Coding, fixed filters are trained offline and achieve high signal adaptivity via a fine-grained gradient-based classifier, resulting in a large number of fixed filters that introduce redundancy and increased implementation complexity. Reducing this redundancy without compromising artifact suppression, therefore, remains a key challenge. This paper proposes an alternative graph-based fixed-filtering framework for adaptive loop filtering. By using a graph to encode pixel-intensity relationships, our approach captures local structural information more effectively than gradient-based classification alone. Fixed filters are learned as polynomial graph filters, enabling structurally similar local patterns to share common filtering behavior. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a comparable performance to the ECM baseline while reducing the number of required filters by an order of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 제안된 논문은 그래프 기반 고정 필터링 프레임워크를 도입해 픽셀-강도 관계를 그래프로 인코딩하고, 다항 그래프 필터(polynomial graph filters)를 학습하여 구조적으로 유사한 지역 패턴이 필터를 공유하도록 함으로써 ECM의 그레디언트 기반 분류가 만든 많은 고정 필터 수를 약 10배 수준으로 줄이면서 유사한 압축 손실 억제 성능을 유지함.
AI.motivation: ECM의 고정 필터들은 오프라인 학습과 세밀한 그레디언트 기반 분류로 높은 신호 적응성을 얻었으나, 그 결과 필터 수가 매우 많아 중복과 구현 복잡도가 증가한다. 중복을 줄이되 아티팩트 제거 성능을 유지하는 것이 핵심 도전이다.
AI.method: 픽셀 강도 관계를 그래프로 모델링하여 지역 구조 정보를 포착하고, 다항 그래프 필터를 학습해 구조적으로 유사한 패턴들이 동일한 필터 동작을 공유하도록 함. 그래프 기반 표현으로 기존 그레디언트 분류보다 구조적 유사성에 기반한 필터 재사용을 가능하게 함.
AI.result: 제안한 방법은 ECM 기준선과 유사한 성능을 보이면서 요구되는 필터 수를 한 자릿수(약 10배) 감소시킴.
AI.conclusion: 그래프 기반 필터링은 고정 필터 수를 크게 줄이면서도 압축 아티팩트 억제 성능을 유지할 수 있으며, 실질적인 구현 복잡도와 저장 비용 절감 가능성을 제시함.

title: Estimating Hydrodynamic Coefficients for Floating Offshore Structures from Movement Data Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: We present a method for estimating the hydrodynamic coefficients in the Cummins equations using time-series data from a moving body, such as a floating offshore structure. The proposed data-driven method is based on incorporating the Cummins equations governing the dynamics of a structural body interacting with water waves into a physics-informed neural network (PINN), along with available motion data. The proposed method first estimates the structure's state in terms of translational and rotational degrees of freedom, and then solves the inverse problem to determine the hydrodynamic forces acting on the body, expressed in terms of added mass, damping coefficients, and/or hydrostatic restoring. The Cummins equations are formulated as a first-order system, and both state and parameter estimation are performed using PINNs. The method is verified on the free decay of a sphere and a box. The results demonstrate that it is possible to estimate the state and hydrodynamic coefficients accurately, although accuracy depends on the volume and quality of the movement data.

AI.tldr: Cummins 방정식을 PINN과 결합해 관성, 감쇠, 복원 계수 등 수력계수와 상태(병진·회전)를 시계열 운동 데이터로 역추정하는 방법을 제시. 구체적으로 Cummins 방정식을 1차 미분계 시스템으로 구성하고 PINN으로 상태 및 파라미터를 동시 추정. 구형·박스의 자유감쇠 사례에서 데이터 양·품질에 따라 높은 정확도를 보임.
AI.motivation: 해양 구조물의 설계·제어에 필수적인 수력계수를 실험이나 고해상 시뮬레이션 없이 현장계측(운동 시계열)만으로 효율적·정확하게 추정하고자 함. 특히 복잡한 파랑 상호작용을 다루는 Cummins 모델을 물리정보 기반 기계학습에 통합해 역문제 해결의 안정성·일반화를 개선하려는 목적.
AI.method: Cummins 방정식을 운동학적 상태(병진·회전 DOF)와 수력력(가산질량, 감쇠 계수, 정수복원 등)으로 기술하고 이를 1차 상태공간 형태로 변형. 관측된 운동 시계열을 PINN의 손실함수에 포함하여 물리적 제약(미분방정식 잔차)과 데이터 적합을 동시에 최적화. 상태 추정과 파라미터(수력계수) 추정을 동시 수행하며, 사례 검증으로 자유감쇠 실험(구·박스)의 합성/실측 유사 데이터 사용.
AI.result: 합성 자유감쇠 사례에서 상태(변위·속도·각도 등)와 가산질량·감쇠·복원 계수를 정확하게 복원함. 다만 추정 정확도는 운동 데이터의 시간 길이, 샘플링 빈도, 노이즈 수준 등 데이터 양·품질에 민감함. 일부 파라미터는 공선성 또는 식별성 문제로 불확실성 증가 가능.
AI.conclusion: PINN 기반 Cummins 역추정은 실용적인 경로를 제공하며, 충분·양질의 운동 데이터가 있으면 수력계수를 신뢰성 있게 추정할 수 있음. 향후에는 잡음·불완전 관측, 공간·주파수 종속 계수(시간·주파수 비정상성) 처리, 실제 해양 데이터를 이용한 추가 검증이 필요.

title: A Multipurpose Thermal Convection Setup to Study Turbulent Super Structures
summary: A thermal convection apparatus has been designed to study turbulent super structures at high Rayleigh numbers and Prandtl numbers of the order of unity. This apparatus consists of a rectangular cell with a length of $3.50\,\mathrm{m}$, width of $0.35\,\mathrm{m}$, and variable height, which is fixed at $0.70\,\mathrm{m}$ for the present study. This cell is installed inside a $5.6\,\mathrm{m}$ long pressure vessel facility, known as \emph{Göttingen Uboot}, which can be filled with compressed gasses (air, helium, nitrogen, or sulfur hexafluoride) at pressures up to $19\,\mathrm{bar}$, enabling Rayleigh numbers up to $ Ra \leq 5\times 10^{12}$ and Prandtl numbers of approximately $0.7 \leq Pr \leq 0.9$. The convection cell is bounded vertically by top and bottom plates consisting of a three-layer composite structure in which a thin Lexan plate is sandwiched between highly conductive aluminum plates. This allows for spatially resolved heat flux measurements. Each plate is subdivided into four longitudinal segments that can be independently temperature-controlled to enable homogeneous temperatures and the imposition of horizontal temperature gradients at both the top and bottom boundaries. While the bottom plate is electrically heated, the top plate's temperature is regulated using temperature-controlled circulating pressurized water. The apparatus is well suited for precise heat flux measurements, with the results obtained being in good agreement with those previously reported in the literature.

AI.tldr: 대형 압력챔버 내부에 설치된 직사각형 대류셀(3.50×0.35×0.70 m)을 이용해 최대 Ra ≤ 5×10^12, Pr ≈ 0.7–0.9 범위에서 난류 슈퍼구조를 연구하도록 설계된 장치. 얇은 렉산 판을 알루미늄 판 사이에 샌드위치한 3중 구조의 상하 경계판으로 공간분해된 열유속 측정과 4분할의 독립 온도 제어를 지원.
AI.motivation: Rayleigh 수가 매우 큰 난류 열대류(turbulent super structures)를 Pr ~ 1 조건에서 실험적으로 조사하려면 높은 Ra를 확보할 수 있고 경계조건(온도, 수평구배)을 정밀히 제어할 수 있는 대형·고압 설비가 필요했음.
AI.method: 5.6 m 길이의 압력용기(‘Göttingen Uboot’)에 직사각형 대류셀을 장착하고 공기·헬륨·질소·SF6 등으로 19 bar까지 압력 조절. 상·하 판은 얇은 렉산판을 고전도 알루미늄판으로 샌드위치한 3층 복합구조로 제작해 공간분해 열유속 측정 가능. 각 판은 4개 종단분할로 독립 제어 가능, 하부는 전기가열, 상부는 압력순환수로 냉각.
AI.result: 정밀한 열유속 측정이 가능하며 얻은 결과가 기존 문헌과 양호한 일치성을 보임.
AI.conclusion: 경계조건 제어와 높은 Ra 확보가 가능한 실험 플랫폼으로 난류 슈퍼구조 연구에 적합하며, 향후 다양한 프란틀 수·경계조건 실험에 활용 가능하다.

title: Nanosecond DBD-Induced Shock and Thermal Perturbations on Blunt Bodies in Hypersonic Flow
summary: Nanosecond-pulsed dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma actuators were investigated on a generic blunt body in a Mach 6 Ludwieg tube to characterize the pressure and thermal perturbations relevant to hypersonic boundary-layer transition control. Complementary quiescent experiments were also conducted over ambient pressures representative of those predicted in the model nose region to isolate the influence of local thermodynamic conditions on actuator operation. Pulse-energy measurements and schlieren imaging showed that decreasing pressure reduced the deposited electrical energy per pulse, weakened the actuator-generated shock, and increased the spatial extent of the residual heated region owing to energy deposition over a larger plasma volume. Under Mach 6 Ludwieg-tube conditions, the actuator-generated shock interacted with and reflected from the detached bow shock, temporarily increasing the bow-shock stand-off distance by approximately 11%, while the residual heated region was advected downstream along the body. The schlieren images further permitted the evolution of the thermal disturbance to be distinguished from that of the actuator-generated shock.
